info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Treasury Asset Securitization-spec
info.description: The Treasury Asset Securitization API facilitates the seamless creation of asset securitization structures within treasury operations. This API allows users to define and manage complex financial instruments that transform illiquid assets into marketable securities. Ideal for financial institutions and asset managers, it provides functionalities to initiate asset-backed financing mechanisms, enhancing liquidity and capital efficiency. Users can integrate this API into their banking systems to streamline treasury processes and optimize funding strategies.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new asset securitization within the treasury system. It accepts the necessary data to generate a securitization instrument and processes the request accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new asset securitization operation. It should include all necessary parameters that define the securitization details, including asset types, values, and any applicable regulatory information.
